ideas.title: Minnesota Fraud Cases on the Rise
ideas.description: Investigating the recent surge in fraud cases in Minnesota, including a personal care assistant accused of billing Medicaid $116K for services not provided.
ideas.angle: Following the money trail in Minnesota's fraud cases
questions: What is causing the rise in fraud cases?
How can we prevent similar cases in the future?
ideas.insight: The rise in reported fraud cases in Minnesota suggests a need for increased scrutiny of programs and potential termination of those found to be fraudulent.
